question:
**Fill in the blank with the most appropriate idiom:**

The CEO resigned, citing personal reasons, but insiders knew it was just a _______.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3 (red herring)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"red herring"** refers to something that misleads or distracts from the actual issue. (गुमराह करने वाला या ध्यान भटकाने वाला)
 
 
• **Example:** The politician introduced a red herring by discussing unrelated matters to avoid answering the tough question.
 
 
• In the context of the sentence, the CEO’s personal reasons were a distraction from the real reasons for his resignation.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3 (red herring)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Can of worms** (मुसीबतों का पिटारा): Refers to a complicated or problematic situation that could lead to trouble.
 
 
• **Example:** Trying to change the law might open a can of worms for the government.
 
 
 
• **Slip of the tongue** (जुबान फिसलना): Refers to an unintentional mistake in speech.
 
 
• **Example:** His slip of the tongue revealed the surprise party plan.
 
 
 
• **Feather in the cap** (सम्मान की बात): Refers to an achievement or honor that adds prestige.
 
 
• **Example:** Winning the championship was a feather in his cap.
